items.t: Intake or head gasket failure and coolant loss
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets
items.note: If a head gasket has failed or the engine overheated, expect much more.

items.t: Heater blows only cold air
items.job: Replace heater blend door actuator
items.note: If the blend door itself is broken, the dash may need to come apart and it costs more.

items.t: AWD driveshaft center bearing or U-joint wear
items.job: Replace rear driveshaft assembly
items.note: Some shops can replace only the center bearing or U-joint, which costs less.

items.t: Key sticks in the ignition
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder
items.note: Some 2005 models had a shift lock recall. Check your VIN. If the switch also failed, it adds a little.

items.t: Excessive oil burning
items.job: Replace pistons and piston rings (2.4L)
items.note: An old GM special coverage paid for this but has likely expired. Ask the dealer. Timing chain work is often added.

items.t: Timing chain stretch
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners (3.0L V6)
items.note: If a chain jumped and damaged the valves, expect much more.

items.t: Windshield wipers suddenly stop
items.job: Replace front wiper module and linkage
items.note: Covered by a GM recall or special coverage on many years. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Front intermediate driveshaft can break
items.job: Replace right front intermediate driveshaft
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak from missing endcap bolts
items.job: Inspect and replace transmission start/stop accumulator
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN. If the transmission ran low on fluid, damage may cost much more.

items.t: Power loss or misfire in very cold weather
items.job: Replace or update charge air cooler (1.5L turbo)
items.note: Sometimes fixed with a dealer software update or bulletin repair. Ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank seam leak on AWD models
items.job: Replace fuel tank
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Rear brakes may drag
items.job: Replace rear brake calipers and related parts
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN. Pads and rotors may also need replacing if they overheated.

items.t: Engine stall from weak fuel pump module
items.job: Replace fuel pump module
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Door striker can break and door may open
items.job: Replace all four door strikers and bolts
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Key can be removed when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition key cylinder lock housing
items.note: Free under recall 16V-502. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Side airbag inflator may rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace seat-mounted side airbag modules
items.note: Free under recall 15V-666. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can come loose and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and fuel pipe
items.note: Free under recall 18V-358. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Soft brake pedal from gas trapped in rear calipers (recall)
items.job: Bleed brake hydraulic system
items.note: Free under recall 18V-576. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Seat belt may be fastened with the wrong bolts (recall)
items.job: Replace seat belt mounting bolts
items.note: Free under recall 20V-811. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver seat frame bolt or weld can fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver seat cushion frame
items.note: Free under recall 22V-724 or 22V-359. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not switch off for a child (recall)
items.job: Replace front passenger presence sensing system
items.note: Free under recall 22V-929. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear child seat anchors hard to latch (recall)
items.job: Inspect and refinish or replace rear LATCH anchor bars
items.note: Free under recall 23V-339. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Camshaft actuator solenoid can cause rough running and stalling
items.job: Replace camshaft position actuator solenoid valves

items.t: Rear main seal oil leak from a blocked crankcase vent passage
items.job: Clean crankcase vent passage and replace rear main seal
items.note: Some cars had GM special coverage 14882. Ask a dealer whether it was done.
